summary: Otter Wiki is a lightweight documentation tool that processes Markdown files to generate a browsable knowledge base. It provides a straightforward interface for teams or individuals looking to maintain text-based documentation without a heavy database backend.
goodFor: It suits small teams or self-hosters who want a simple, file-backed wiki that is quick to set up using standard container tooling.
watchOut: As a minimalist wiki, it lacks the advanced permission management, enterprise integrations, and extensive plugin ecosystems found in larger alternatives.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker, which typically requires mapping a persistent volume for your content files and configuring a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
